Cart Management
Modified on Mon, 7 Apr, 2025 at  4:45 PM
The shopping cart feature allows you to add multiple products to a cart, review your entire order with the payable amount, and place orders for all added products in one go.
The Cart
1. Navigate to a product's detail page
2. Fill in all required fields (denomination, quantity, etc.)
3. Click the Add to Cart button
Once a product is added, the button will change to Go to Cart
The counter on the cart icon will increase by 1
A success message will appear: "Product is successfully added to the cart."
Cart Limitations
The cart has the following limitations:
Feature
Limitation
Currencies
Maximum 5 different currencies
Products per currency
Maximum 15 products
Total products in the cart
Maximum 75 (15 × 5)
Denominations per product
Maximum 15 different denominations & quantity combinations
Without GV: Max quantity per denomination
250 items
With GV: Max quantity per denomination
1,000 items
Cart with Products
If your cart contains products, you'll see:
1. Currency sections
2. List of added products with their respective:
3. Denomination
4. Quantity
5. Total amount
6. Discount (if applicable)
7. Total payable amount per item
8. Total payable amount for the entire purchase per currency
Checkout Process
1. Review your cart items and total payable amount
2. Click the Checkout button
3. Confirm your purchase in the confirmation dialog
4. Upon confirmation:
The amount will be deducted from your respective wallets
You will be redirected to the Orders page.
Your cart will be cleared.
Note: You must place orders for all products in a selected currency. Partial orders are not allowed.

Gift Cards
Modified on Mon, 7 Apr, 2025 at  4:45 PM
Gift Cards in The Reward Store allow users to redeem store credit or prepaid value for purchases, offering a flexible and convenient way to shop. They can be used as a payment method for eligible products within the store.
How can you purchase Gift Cards at Rewards Store?
1. To purchase gift login to app.thereward.store/login.
2. Enter the details required as in Email and Password and complete the CAPTCHA.
3. Navigate to "Gift Cards" section and click on it.
4. Browse available gift card options and filter by specific brands.
5. Select your gift card by choosing the brand and select the desired denomination, quantity.
6. Review your selection, click "Add to Cart", then proceed to the Cart section and select "Place Order".
7. After placing the order, the wallet balance will be deducted by the voucher amount. Go to the Orders section to view your recent order.
8. In the Orders section, you will find your voucher ready for download and redemption. Click Download to use it online or in-store.

Reports
Modified on Mon, 7 Apr, 2025 at  4:46 PM
The Reports section of The Reward Store helps businesses keep track of all purchases, rewards used, and user activity. It makes it easy to see how rewards are spent, understand customer behavior, and improve the reward program for better results.
How do you find Reports in the Rewards Store Dashboard?
1. Log in to The Reward Store.
2. Navigate to the Reports section in the dashboard. Select the report category you need.
3. Click "Request Report" and you will be redirected to the below page.
4. Choose the type of report you need from the dropdown menu (Order History, Transaction History, Catalog & Recharge History). Then, select the required date range and enter a report name before generating the report.
5. After entering all the required details, click "Generate Report" to create and download the report.
6. After the report is generated, it will be available in the Requested Report section. You can then proceed to download the document.
